model.capacity_time_basis: 92-day quarter; integrate active eligible IT MW by activation/retirement date, then integrate utilization over the same interval. 850 MW is an addition, not opening/average/exit fleet capacity.
model.cash_flow_guardrail: Prepayments are already in OCF. Do not subtract net cash capex from unadjusted OCF: that counts their benefit twice. OCF less identified prepayments is a timing diagnostic, not normalized earnings, OCI margin or an alternative GAAP measure.

conditional_relations: For a fixed facility MW and revenue, R/effective_IT_MW scales as PUE/utilization.
For fixed IT MW and revenue, PUE changes power cost, not the IT denominator.
With fixed active IT MW, effective-MW revenue varies inversely with utilization; it is not evidence of a higher realized selling price.
Delta annual power cost per IT MW = 8760 * delta_PUE * tariff_USD_per_MWh; tariff remains undisclosed.

pue.aggregation: sum(facility_MWh)/sum(IT_MWh); equivalently IT-energy-weighted PUE. Never site-count averaging.
pue.basis: No matched energy pair or usable measured/design PUE found. FY25 corporate energy includes Scopes 1 and 2; it does not isolate OCI AI facilities or IT energy. Power-based customer reporting exists but public fleet totals are absent. Cooling design alone does not calibrate overhead.
pue.boundary: OCI AI-compute fleet: total facility energy / IT-equipment energy over identical sites and periods
pue.proxy_transfer: No external universal PUE transferred. Direct-to-chip closed-loop cooling at one development is not a measured OCI fleet ratio.
